tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Find a free online tool on CodeKitHub (there are hundreds: converters, calculators, generators, text, code and image tools). Returns the tool page link.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert between units of length, mass, volume, area, speed, time, data size and temperature, e.g. 5 miles to km or 72 F to C.

tools.name: calculate_age
tools.description: Exact age from a birth date: years, months, days, total days and days until the next birthday.

tools.name: date_difference
tools.description: Days, weeks and calendar years/months/days between two dates.

tools.name: calculate_percentage
tools.description: Percentage maths. percent_of: a% of b. what_percent: a is what % of b. percent_change: change from a to b.

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Compound interest with optional monthly contributions: final balance, total contributed and interest earned.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Count characters, words, sentences, paragraphs and lines, and estimate reading time.

tools.name: convert_case
tools.description: Change text case: upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, pascal, snake, kebab or constant.

tools.name: encode_decode
tools.description: Encode or decode text: Base64, URL, HTML entities, hex.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: SHA hash of a text (SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512). Do not send secrets you need to keep private.

tools.name: timestamp_convert
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) or an ISO date to both forms; "now" gives the current time.

tools.name: color_convert
tools.description: Convert a colour between HEX, RGB and HSL.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "hash_text" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
